fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. The blow deals 22 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Beating the Brush
fusions.desc: Beats the ground ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long with a 30% chance to leave each [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Beaters' Cry
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Wounded Quarry
fusions.desc: Against a target carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
